=== getent auth.localhost ===
exit=2
=== curl to issuer without resolve ===
HTTP 000
exit=6
=== curl with --resolve (proves kc+traefik work) ===
HTTP 200

observation.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== getent auth.localhost ==="; getent hosts auth.localhost; echo "exit=$?"; echo "=== curl to issuer without resolve ==="; curl -s -m 8 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://auth.localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/protocol/openid-connect/certs; echo "exit=$?"; echo "=== curl with --resolve (proves kc+traefik work) ==="; curl -s -m 8 --resolve auth.localhost:3000:127.0.0.1 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://auth.localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/protocol/openid-connect/certs
